newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar appoints first female undersecretary.
newsitem.headline: Qatar appoints first female undersecretary.

text.p: The conservative Gulf Arab state of Qatar broke decades of male-dominated government on Tuesday by appointing its first woman to a senior post, an official said.
Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani issued a decree on Tuesday appointing Sheikha Ahmed al-Mahmoud undersecretary at the Ministry of Education and Culture, said the official.
She had served in the ministry before her appointment.
Women in Qatar and other conservative Gulf Arab states have limited roles in senior government positions.
